Neuroscience & coursework

Archived undergraduate research, preserving the original context and methods. No longer updated.

Jul 2021 — May 2022

LPFC Population Responses in Working Memory Error Trials

Studied population coding in monkey working-memory error trials, building on prior work on stable subspaces. Focused on the 300 ms pre-motor activity in LPFC and FEF. Used PCA and LDA to define subspaces and reduce noise, and PSTHs to examine the distribution of error and aborted trials across task stages.

Jun 2019 — Jun 2022

Neural Circuits Underlying Motion Vision in Drosophila Larvae

Investigated motion discrimination and image recognition in Drosophila larvae using reinforcement learning, providing a behavioral basis for network-dynamics modeling in a well-defined visual circuit.

View dataset

Jun 2019 — Jun 2022

Neural Control of the Wing Held-up Phenotype in PRL-1 Mutant Flies

Explored neuronal control of the wing held-up phenotype in PRL-1 mutant Drosophila, following work that excluded other factors such as muscle cells.

Nov 2021 · Course project

Whole-brain fMRI Analysis & Picture Valence Prediction

Based on a published paper, used ANOVA in R to screen data before predicting valence with classification and regression. Multilayer neural networks and SVMs performed above chance; linear regression produced similar results.

Nov 2021 · Course project

Retinal Scan Image Analysis

Developed Python software to detect glaucoma and measure vessel length. Built two CNN models based on optic disc and cup radii, with accuracy reported in the original project at approximately 0.8–0.9. Used OpenCV segmentation for vessel measurement and developed a GUI.
